answer: Let attestation weight decay unless renewed every epoch, and delay each new identity's first vote by a lockup that grows with its rank in the funding tree. A farm spinning a nebula of clones finds only the earliest few can vote soon; the rest wait at the jetty with capital locked, and by the time they unlock, the earlier clones have decayed from idleness. Building a bridge of honest attestations across many epochs becomes the only cheap path to weight, so bulk minting pays late and little, while steady honest work compounds.
